text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning, I ran into Yaeno Muteki, who 
looked a bit spaced out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry. I went to bed right on 
time last night as well, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When I close my eyes, they just keep 
coming to mind for some reason. Martial 
arts, races—all the battles I've fought so 
far...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hence, even as I lay in bed, my heart was 
surging, leaving me completely unable to 
sleep. Truly... a blunder on my part.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Yaeno Muteki wasn't able to 
get much rest.
